versions.text: Criterion: Verify that visual cues for both unassisted and night vision devices (NVD) are adequate for safe operations on all planned spots day and night. Standard: Provide piloted simulation, land-based flight test data, or analysis against historical standards to show this is safe. A logical and measured flight test build-up from benign to more stressing conditions may be allowable in lieu of this data. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, design, test, or configuration documentation.
